summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns covering August 17-21, 2026. These returns report a series of share repurchases on the HKEX (stock code 02390) for cancellation. Daily buybacks range from approximately 77,673 to 135,000 shares at prices between USD 1.0416 and USD 1.0944 per share, aggregating around 20 consecutive trading sessions starting July 1, 2026. The repurchases appear part of a broader capital return program, reducing issued share capital. The US-listed ADR holders should monitor the pace of buybacks and potential reduction in share count, which could be accretive to per-share metrics.
